transcript.text: I reviewed the county health guidance for the pantry this week, and I need to share some important requirements. The guidance specifies that refrigerated food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or colder, with the temperature logged every 2 hours while the pantry is open. It also requires that sealed packages display allergen labels. I have the printed guidance in my health-office binder, but I haven't yet added these requirements to the pantry draft plan. Our current draft only proposes a weekly temperature check, which falls short of the every-2-hours logging requirement, and we need to make sure the district's standard food-labeling procedure includes allergen labels on sealed packages.
